top.description: Player 1 background (Naruto + Sasuke). Formato cuadrado 1:1, personajes a los lados, centro abierto.
top.prompt: A stunning, epic 2D anime illustration in the classic Naruto Shippuden Toei animation style, square format 1:1. A single continuous, seamless, and unified landscape of the Valley of the End's roaring waterfall between the colossal stone statues of Hashirama and Madara under a dramatic dark cloudy sky with golden sun rays, spanning the entire width. On the left side of this same landscape stands Naruto Uzumaki (Shippuden teenager version, orange and black jacket) in a dynamic combat stance, enveloped in a swirling blue and orange chakra aura, charging a Rasengan. On the right side of this same landscape stands Sasuke Uchiha (Shippuden teenager version, grey shirt) in an agile sword stance, surrounded by crackling purple Chidori lightning. Both characters are naturally integrated into the same single-picture scenery and are drawn slightly smaller to fit entirely within the frame with a safe margin from the outer edges. The center is empty and clean. No split screen, no vertical dividers, no black bars, no empty black columns, no black panels. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, cropped characters, split screen, black bars, vertical dividers, black columns, black panels

loader.description: Pantalla de carga: Naruto vs Pain jugando una partida REAL y correcta de Magic. Vertical 9:16 mobile.
loader.prompt: A humorous and epic 2D anime scene of a card match in the classic Naruto Shippuden style, vertical portrait composition, aspect ratio 9:16. Naruto Uzumaki (Shippuden teenager version) and Pain (Tendo path) are seated properly and facing each other across the wooden bar of the Ichiraku Ramen shop, playing a game of Magic. Naruto is concentrating intensely over his cards with a bead of sweat, while Pain has a calm, sinister smile. Both characters hold their cards facing themselves (only the card backs are visible to the camera). On the table, between two steaming bowls of ramen, is a detailed Magic: The Gathering card layout: rows of fantasy cards with some cards turned horizontally at 90-degrees to indicate they are tapped, and a glowing blue chakra die. Warm, cozy ramen shop lighting, vibrant cel-shading. --ar 9:16 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, backward cards
